Support that starts with being understood.

NDIS Support Coordinator (Level 2) and Psychosocial Recovery Coach. Based in Woolooware and working across Sydney, Heidi helps participants of all ages, backgrounds and support needs make sense of their plan, connect with the right people, and feel genuinely supported.

Support Coordinator, Level 2. Psychosocial Recovery Coach. Sole trader, one point of contact, always.

Two roles, one purpose.

Heidi works as both a Support Coordinator (Level 2) and a Psychosocial Recovery Coach: two roles that, together, cover the practical and the personal side of navigating the NDIS.

She's easy to reach, quick to reply, and never makes anyone feel like a number on a spreadsheet.

Support Coordination

Turning a complex plan into a clear, workable set of supports.

Recovery Coaching

Steady, strengths-based support through mental health recovery.

A good plan needs a good person behind it.

Anyone can read your NDIS plan out loud. What actually helps is someone who translates it into real, workable support: patiently, in plain English, without making you chase them for answers.

Every story is different. That's the whole point.

Heidi works alongside participants from all kinds of backgrounds and circumstances, because good support meets people where they are, not where a template expects them to be.

  • Psychosocial disability
  • Intellectual disability
  • Autism
  • Acquired brain injury
  • Physical disability
  • Sensory disability
  • Complex trauma & mental illness
  • Multicultural & CALD backgrounds
  • Ageing carers & families
  • Young people building independence

How Heidi can help.

Two complementary services, one consistent point of contact from start to finish.

Support Coordination, Level 2

  • Understanding what your plan actually funds, in plain English
  • Connecting you with the right providers, not just any provider
  • Stepping in when things get complicated or urgent
  • Building your confidence to manage more of it yourself over time

Psychosocial Recovery Coaching

  • Recovery-focused, strengths-based support for mental health
  • Practical help building routines, skills and daily confidence
  • A steady presence through harder periods, without judgement
  • Working alongside your clinical team, family and community

Easy to reach

A phone call or message away, not a ticket in a queue.

Straight answers, no jargon

NDIS language explained the way you'd explain it to a friend.

Judgement-free, always

Whoever you are, whatever your circumstances, you're welcome here.
